edges.detail: Prime, Exchange and retail app; supported regions; announcement dated 2026-10-28
Coinbase states Ripple will provide liquidity on Base
XRPL daily snapshot USD 707.36M at 2026-10-31 01:00 UTC; rolling 24h net change -USD 67.6M
Ethereum supply approximately USD 1.71B; rolling 24h net mint +USD 19.6M

hypotheses.claim: Some of the XRPL RLUSD decrease reflects movement to Ethereum or Base following Coinbase's multichain support.
supporting: Coinbase announced XRPL, Base and Ethereum deposit/withdrawal support on 2026-10-28.
Ethereum supply increased USD 19.6M in the same rolling 24h panel.
disconfirming: Ethereum's increase offsets only part of the XRPL decrease.
Base supply is excluded from the dashboard and labeled testing.
No transaction-level bridge path or matching mint/burn IDs were obtained.

hypotheses.claim: Some of the XRPL RLUSD decrease reflects issuer redemptions/burns rather than chain migration.
supporting: XRPL gateway_balances snapshot and rolling net supply both declined.
disconfirming: No transaction-level burn/redemption IDs were obtained for this exact window.
The cross-chain supply scope excludes Base.

hypotheses.claim: Part of the apparent magnitude or timing difference reflects snapshot-window, feed availability or provider-scope limitations.
supporting: Dashboard reported live feed unavailable and a snapshot refresh age; daily and rolling windows differ.
Base is outside the stated two-chain scope.
disconfirming: The daily XRPL supply figure is displayed directly from gateway_balances methodology; a genuine supply decline is still indicated.

hypotheses.claim: The RLUSD supply decline caused a directional XRP price move or proves net XRP capital inflow/outflow.
disconfirming: RLUSD is a separate issued stablecoin; no XRP trade, bridge, order-book or issuer purchase crosswalk links the RLUSD supply change to XRP price.

graph_limitations: Coinbase's supported-network announcement is not evidence of actual deposits, withdrawals or cross-chain transfers.
The dashboard's two-chain RLUSD supply excludes Base and does not provide a transaction-level chain-migration reconciliation.
XRP exchange-wallet totals include customer omnibus balances, cold storage and 487.2M XRP in wrapped/operational reserves; they are not tradable float.
The current XRP Insights page differs materially from a prior same-day capture on 30-day aggregate and venue changes; both observations must be preserved.
